english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something located beneath A, including movement beneath A when used with a movement verb.
This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for something spatially lower than A.
This is the all-purpose choice for something physically below or concealed under something else.
This is the all-purpose choice for something positioned underneath or below something else.

examples.english: The car stopped under the bridge.
examples.traditional: 架車喺條橋下面停低咗。
